statistics.marginals: Successful observations only. Median and IQR use linear quantile interpolation; p95 uses nearest rank ceil(0.95*n). Failures retained as counts.
statistics.paired_effect: Median of within-block DoH minus UDP differences; percentage is median of paired percentage differences, not ratio of marginal medians.
statistics.interval: Exploratory percentile 95% interval from 4000 bootstrap resamples of complete paired blocks within each observed window. Window counts remain fixed. Conditional on these sampled windows, names, network and successful pairs. Repeated domains and serial dependence may narrow intervals; no population coverage claim.
statistics.unit_lookup: Provider, domain, window, repetition matched block. Protocol responses are paired before resampling.
statistics.unit_page: Provider, layout, window, repetition matched navigation block. Nested resource queries are not independent pages.
statistics.robustness: Per-window paired medians, leave-one-window-out medians, and per-domain lookup effects. Three windows are insufficient for robust between-window inference. Page p95 with 30 observations is descriptive.
statistics.missingness: No imputation. Successful paired effect conditions on both modes succeeding; discordant successes and missing records are reported.

page_treatment_audit.interpretation: DoH query preexisting=true is expected in both page modes because the collector explicitly opens the connection before querying. Continuous numbering (fresh 1..N, established 2..N+1), identical stored connect_ms, h2 and no TLS resumption were checked per page. No socket UUID was recorded.

self_checks: Passed in-memory arithmetic and deterministic bootstrap checks
